claims.claim: Sharp AR-M201 All-in-One Digital Copier for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Sharp multifunction/copier with the lid open and a Sharp-branded control panel area, but the exact model/series text (AR-M201/M201) is not clearly readable in the provided report.
Photos show a unit with lid open and internal parts visible, but the report does not include clear evidence of wear level (e.g., heavy scuffs, corrosion, or usage counters).
No test results are shown in the witness report (no print/copy/fax success, no error codes, no output samples).
The seller’s statement is truncated; the report does not show the missing part (e.g., ready to print/copy) nor any functional proof.
The witness report notes brand text visible near the control panel, but model number/series number is listed as not clearly readable.

risks.risk: Not actually functional (no proof of printing/copying; could have scanner/ADF/rollers/laser or firmware issues).
risks.proof: A short video or live demonstration showing a successful copy (place a page on glass, press copy, show the output) plus no error messages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested (worst case for a remote buyer).

risks.risk: Cartridge/toner or imaging unit condition unknown (could be low/empty or worn, causing poor prints).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the toner/cartridge and/or imaging unit status, plus a test page showing print quality (faint lines/blank pages indicate issues).

risks.risk: Model number may be wrong or incomplete (AR-M201 vs another Sharp model), affecting parts availability and correct valuation.
risks.proof: A photo of the model/serial label (rear/side/service tag) with the exact model number readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest compatible/most conservative assumption for Sharp multifunction copiers without confirmed model.

risks.risk: Connectivity may not work (USB/Wi‑Fi/Ethernet unknown), limiting usability for the buyer.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of network settings (if Wi‑Fi/Ethernet) and a quick connection test from a laptop/phone showing the device detected and printing a page.
risks.if_unproven: Price as local/limited connectivity until proven.

risks.risk: Missing parts or paper handling problems (tray/rollers intact not confirmed; could jam or feed poorly).
risks.proof: Photos showing all paper trays/doors/rollers closed and intact, plus a short jam-free feeding test (print/copy multiple pages).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential paper-feed/jam risk (worst case).

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage or service issues (internal rollers/rollers wear, scanner glass damage, or worn belts not visible).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of scanning glass, roller surfaces, and any belts/gears visible, plus a test showing consistent output over several pages.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the exact model/serial label (rear/side/service tag) with readable text.
Provide a live demo video: place a page on the glass, press copy, show the printed/copied output and any on-screen status/errors.
Show toner/cartridge and/or imaging unit close-ups, including any visible low/empty indicators.
Show a paper feeding test (copy/print multiple pages) demonstrating no jams and consistent output.
Show connectivity proof: laptop/phone detects the printer/copier and successfully prints a page (USB and/or network as applicable).
Send photos of all trays/doors/rollers (fully closed) to confirm no missing parts.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Sharp multifunction/copier, but the exact model and—most importantly—functional status (printing/copying) and consumable condition are not proven in the report. Without a test shot, pricing would be guesswork, so proof is required.
